subject: Request: latest penetration test package + secure sharing workflow
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@acme-med.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia@healthco.io>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for latest penetration test package and secure access

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well. We’re in the final stages of our SIG/SOC2 evidence gathering for Acme Medical and need the most recent penetration test package for Redwood’s hosted API. Specifically: 
- The full (redacted as needed) penetration test report;
- A remediation tracker or summary showing which findings are open/resolved and dates;
- Any supporting evidence (patch notes, remediation tickets, or verification screenshots).

Can you confirm: 1) whether you can share the report, 2) what secure channels you support (presigned S3, secure evidence portal, encrypted PDF, etc.), and 3) whether an NDA is required prior to delivery? We need to tie the artifacts to our compliance attachments and would like the files by end of next week if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Alex Mercer
Head of Security Programs
Acme Medical
alex.mercer@acme-med.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@acme-med.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia@healthco.io>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test package and secure access

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the timeline. I’ll coordinate with Security and Eng to prepare the package. Quick questions to make sure we provide the right artifacts: 

1) Account context: is this request under the Acme Medical org (ACM-4512) — confirmed in thread?
2) Recipient list: will only you and Sofia need access, or do you have additional legal/compliance contacts who should be provisioned?
3) Preferred transfer method: we can do either a time-limited evidence portal invite (preferred), a presigned S3 object with strict IP restriction, or an encrypted PDF delivered via DocuSign link. We also redact PII by default — if you need a fully unredacted copy we require a signed NDA.

Tentative plan: I’ll loop in Irene (security) for redaction and remediation details and Laura from Eng for validation of fixes. If that works I’ll confirm the sharing link and target delivery by EOW next Friday (2027-02-19).

Would you prefer a short call tomorrow to confirm scope? I can do 11:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Security Lead, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test package and secure access

Neha — adding security details. Summary for the package: 

- Test run: internal + third-party pen test completed 2027-01-20 (scope: hosted API, auth, routing, telemetry).
- High/Critical: none.
- Medium: 3 items — all have either been remediated or mitigated; I will attach the remediation tracker.
- Open low items: 2 (pending scheduled patch 2027-02-21).

Sharing approach (recommended):
1) Create a 30-day evidence portal session for the two external users (Alex, Sofia). Portal will require MFA and will provide download logs.
2) Include an encrypted PDF (password-protected) of the full report for download; password exchanged over a separate channel (SMS or DocuSign note).
3) Attach remediation-summary-ACM-4512.csv with links to internal tickets (RW-ISSUE-1234, RW-ISSUE-1288, RW-ISSUE-1320).

Redaction notes: ongoing redaction is limited to PII and customer-only data (we redact unrelated tenant data). If Acme needs unredacted output — NDA + SOC exec approval required (this is policy).

I’ll prepare the portal invite and the CSV; ETA end of day Tuesday (2027-02-16).

Irene Choi
Security Operations Manager
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 12:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test package and secure access

Quick sales note — Alex/Sofia, if helpful we can include a one-page SOC2-friendly executive summary that highlights "no critical findings" and remediation closure dates. That is often what procurement attaches to SIG/CAIQ responses. I’ll draft and attach exec-onepager-soc2-summary.pdf to the portal as well.

Also happy to set a 20-minute walkthrough with our Security PM to run through findings and mitigations after you review.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@acme-med.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia@healthco.io>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivery: Pen test package access + next steps

Hi Alex / Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the plan below, we’ve prepared the package and portal access: 

What we shared:
- redwood-pt-report-202701-encrypted.pdf (full report, redacted for PII)
- remediation-summary-ACM-4512.csv (status + ticket links)
- exec-onepager-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level summary for procurement)

Access method:
- Evidence portal invitation (one-time link, expires 30 days): https://evidence.redwood.ai/invite/ACM-4512-EXPIRY-30d (link will only work for invited emails)
- Portal requires MFA and logs downloads. We will email you the PDF password via DocuSign secure note in a separate message within the hour.

Notes: 
- If you require an unredacted copy we can proceed only after an executed NDA; please indicate the legal contact if that’s required.
- For traceability we included internal ticket ids: RW-ISSUE-1234 (fixed 2027-01-25), RW-ISSUE-1288 (mitigated 2027-01-28), RW-ISSUE-1320 (in verification; scheduled verification 2027-02-21).

Next steps / ask: 
1) Confirm which external emails need access (we’ve invited Alex and Sofia).
2) Let us know if you want the 20-minute walkthrough — Ben can book this week.
3) If you need any additional artifacts (wireless capture, patch notes screenshots), specify and we’ll surface them.

Attachments referenced: evidence-portal-invite-link.txt (portal invite stub).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Security Lead, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0123
